title: Configuration & Utilities Module
summary: This module provides core functionalities for managing application configuration, performing safe file operations with backups, logging trace messages, and verifying the integrity of downloaded updates.

nodes.label: Save Application Configuration
nodes.title: Save Configuration
nodes.description: Persists application settings and integration configurations to disk, ensuring data integrity and proper file creation.

nodes.label: List Integrations
nodes.title: List Integrations
nodes.description: Retrieves and enumerates all currently configured integrations, handling cases with no integrations and multiple saved entries.

nodes.label: Migrate Configuration Files
nodes.title: Migrate Configuration
nodes.description: Manages the transition of configuration files from legacy locations to new standard paths, including handling corrupt files and ensuring idempotency.

nodes.label: Write File with Backup
nodes.title: Safe File Write
nodes.description: Provides a utility for writing data to files, automatically creating timestamped backups of existing content before modification, and pruning old backups.

nodes.label: Log Trace Messages
nodes.title: Trace Logging
nodes.description: Emits detailed trace-level messages for debugging and operational monitoring, often including contextual information for better analysis.

nodes.label: Verify Downloaded Updates
nodes.title: Update Verification
nodes.description: Validates the integrity and security of downloaded application update bundles by checking for malicious content, invalid paths, and digital signatures.

nodes.label: Configuration Storage
nodes.title: Configuration Files
nodes.description: Persistent storage for application and integration settings, typically JSON files managed on the local file system.

nodes.label: Local File System
nodes.title: File System
nodes.description: The underlying operating system's file storage, used for reading, writing, and managing files and directories.

nodes.label: Application Logging System
nodes.title: Logging Output
nodes.description: The internal system responsible for processing, formatting, and outputting application log messages to various destinations.

nodes.label: Downloaded Update Bundle
nodes.title: Update Package
nodes.description: A compressed archive containing application updates, which must pass rigorous verification checks before being installed.

nodes.label: Security Verification Logic
nodes.title: Security Logic
nodes.description: Internal logic and predefined rules applied to ensure the safety, authenticity, and integrity of downloaded files and application components.

groups.label: Configuration Management
groups.title: Configuration Management
groups.description: Handles the persistence, retrieval, and migration of application settings and integration configurations.

groups.label: File Utilities
groups.title: File Utilities
groups.description: Provides robust file manipulation capabilities, including safe writing with automatic backup creation and management.

groups.label: Logging
groups.title: Logging
groups.description: Implements mechanisms for recording application events and debugging information.

groups.label: Update Management
groups.title: Update Management
groups.description: Ensures the integrity and security of downloaded application updates by performing various checks.
